# External Libraries

## LBFGSpp

LBFGSpp is tracked as a git submodule:

- Path: `external/LBFGSpp`
- URL: `git@github.com:yixuan/LBFGSpp.git`

## nlohmann/json

nlohmann/json is tracked as a git submodule:

- Path: `external/json`
- URL: `https://github.com/nlohmann/json.git`

Initialize/update all external dependencies with:

```bash
git submodule update --init --recursive
```
